about: Recording batch E3d of ADR 0012, CF: the catalogue cases of CF-2 to CF-15, with the contested CF-12 cases (Q-CF-14) and the contested FX-40 cases (Q-FX-17); CF-13/c is given as CF-V2/a, which it also records. Each case is recorded on the CE oracle by a run of the fixtures below, or deferred with a milestone and a reason. CF-6, CF-15 and the hash-pinned FX-40/d runs are deployed through the API (oracle.deploy api), so their trees reach the server as written. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: it reads the deployed flow back with wmill sync pull, and the harness has no pull verb (OR-8 covers the push). CF-6/a's recording holds the value the API answers after the dependency job, which carries the materialized fields, and what generate-metadata writes for the same source

a raw submission or a version whose dependency job failed: outside the reference configuration, where windmill-lite applies the deployed defaults (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 7, Q-CF-13); the harness runs deployed flows by path only
a raw parent submission (Q-CF-15): windmill-lite never runs raw submissions, so ADR 0001 section 6 needs no recording; the harness runs deployed flows by path only

parts.reason: windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6, Q-CF-15); the by-path half, the reference configuration, is recorded

parts.part: the pending-dependency and raw-submission comparison runs ([[-999,-998,-997]])
parts.reason: outside the reference configuration (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6, Q-CF-15); the by-path run after a successful dependency job is recorded, with the outer body's job kind flownode in the provenance
